title: Claim-History Factor on Reconsidered Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claims
content:
**Rule.** On a reconsideration of a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the deductible charged is multiplied by the reconsideration's claim-history factor: 1.75 when three or more paid claims on the plan have a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date, 1.5 when exactly two do, 1.25 when exactly one does, and 1 when none does.

**Points of judgement.**
- A paid claim is a claim of this plan whose handling status is paid.
- The 36 whole months are counted back from the handling date and tested against each claim's loss date.
- Claims on the tenant's other plans are not counted.

**Hypothetical cases.** Paid claims with loss dates 2, 14 and 35 months before the handling date are three paid claims, so the multiplier is 1.75. A single paid claim with a loss date 37 months before leaves none in the window, so the multiplier is 1. One paid claim and one claim approved but unpaid, both in the window, count as one paid claim, so the multiplier is 1.25.
